reason: DOA derives a training-free streaming read/write policy from decoder-only SpeechLLM self-attention and evaluates off-the-shelf Phi-4 Multimodal and Qwen3-Omni. It is a direct Stage-1B method-path candidate whose mechanism, datasets, and frozen boundary require page-level confirmation.

The paper claims independent pitch/pronunciation control with an off-the-shelf speech synthesizer and an acoustic pronunciation distance. It is retained for one bounded full-text read as a representation/control instrument candidate, not as presumed frozen SpeechMLLM core evidence.
DivInit is a training-free, matched-compute intervention for diversifying the first branch of parallel test-time search, directly informing best-of-N candidate allocation.
CyclicReflex is a zero-extra-compute, training-free logit intervention that schedules self-reflection tokens, providing a direct comparator for inference-time control.
VISTA combines activation-space and token-logit steering without training or external supervision, making it a direct multimodal decoding-control transfer candidate.
Imagine-then-Plan includes a training-free adaptive-lookahead variant that trades goal completion against task progress, relevant to dynamic rollout depth and stopping decisions.
CLiViS is a training-free orchestration framework that separates task planning, frozen-model perception, and iterative state updates, a useful systems analogue for frozen omni-model control.
Visual Agentic Memory is a training-free retention, indexing, retrieval, and evidence-verification pipeline; it provides an inspectable memory substrate rather than latent-state-only compression.
A-MEM exposes a reusable implementation of dynamically indexed and linked agent memory, relevant to the planned Stage-1B knowledge-base environment.
VisionTrim is a plug-and-play, training-free token-selection and complement mechanism that may transfer to acoustic-token budget control.
SkillSmith compiles large procedural skill packages into bounded runtime interfaces, directly relevant to a compact, executable research knowledge base.
LLaVA-CoT's stage-wise retracing search is an open, reproducible trained-system comparator for structured multimodal test-time scaling.
MAGIC-Video is a training-free multimodal memory graph plus narrative-chain retrieval loop, offering a second, graph-structured memory design distinct from online retention.
DPRM changes diffusion-model token ordering with a process-reward-guided Doob transform and Soft-BoN approximation; the ordering/controller boundary is directly relevant to reward-guided inference.
EasyEdit2 packages parameter-preserving test-time steering-vector generation and application as an inspectable framework, providing an implementation reference for activation steering.
ASC-MQRA uses repeated stochastic inference, vote-margin uncertainty, and conditional re-arbitration without training; its negative test result also informs abstention and stopping design.
SAGE is a train-free visual-evidence calibration and routing intervention derived from an internal attention failure analysis, offering a second modality-specific steering analogue.
EvilGenie is an open benchmark for detecting reward hacking with held-out tests, judges, edit detection, and human review, directly relevant to verifier/falsifier design.
Gome replaces scalar-score tree enumeration with structured diagnostic updates, success memory, and multi-trace execution; it is an optimizer-design transfer candidate.
Self-Correcting RAG combines budgeted context selection with NLI-guided MCTS and answer validation, an open reference for jointly allocating evidence and search compute.
Bayesian Red Teaming is a query-budgeted black-box optimization loop that uses past evaluations to seek diverse failures; it is a direct transfer reference for efficient falsifier search.
